title: CTV measurement: Metrics & KPIs you should track to prove performance

facts.fact: StackAdapt's article cites eMarketer's forecast that CTV ad spending will reach $46.89 billion USD in 2028, the year eMarketer predicts CTV will surpass traditional linear TV ad spending.
facts.quote: reach $46.89 billion USD in 2028, the same year EMARKETER predicts it will officially surpass traditional linear TV ad spending.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that CPMs for CTV are typically higher than other digital advertising, with rates often ranging from $15 to $30 USD.
facts.quote: CPMs are typically higher in CTV than in other forms of digital advertising, with rates often ranging from $15 to $30 USD.

facts.fact: Per StackAdapt, the conversion rate for CTV is calculated by dividing total CTV-certified conversions by total CTV-certified visits and multiplying by 100.
facts.quote: This is calculated by dividing the total number of CTV-certified conversions by the total number of CTV-certified visits and multiplying by 100 to arrive at the conversion percentage.

facts.fact: StackAdapt describes CTV measurement as placing a 1x1 pixel on the CTV creative and the advertiser's landing page to record pixel events tied to viewer actions.
facts.quote: a 1×1 pixel is placed on the [CTV creative](https://www.stackadapt.com/resources/blog/ctv-creative-best-practices) and the advertiser’s landing page.

facts.fact: StackAdapt defines cost per completed view (CPCV) as the amount an advertiser pays to a CTV platform or inventory provider when an ad is viewed through to completion.
facts.quote: CPCV measures the amount an advertiser pays to a CTV platform or ad inventory provider when an ad is viewed through to completion.

facts.fact: In a StackAdapt-hosted case cited by the vendor, agency Add3Connect's CTV campaign for client Nuun improved relative lift for ad recall by 18.7%, measured with an in-platform brand lift study.
facts.quote: demonstrate how their CTV campaign improved relative lift for ad recall by +18.7%

facts.fact: A brand lift study measures incremental lift through metrics such as brand awareness, ad recall, and brand favourability.
facts.quote: A brand lift study shows incremental lift through metrics like brand awareness, ad recall, and brand favourability.

facts.fact: A brand lift study is survey-based and compares survey results from users exposed to a CTV campaign with a control group that was not exposed.
facts.quote: comparing the results of users who have been exposed to your CTV campaign and a control group who haven’t
